一、 密碼同選課密碼。
二、 91學年度（含）前畢業生密碼仍維持四碼(預設身分證末四碼)。
三、 密碼查詢，請至選課系統密碼查詢。
A.   Password is same as course selection (preset: last 6 digits of ROC ID)
B.   Password is 6 digits. Overseas Chinese /International students: birth date (4digits) + first 2 letter of your name (e.g. James Bond 1960/06/20, password: 0620JA)
C.   Forgot password? Go to the course selection system, or present your ID at the counter
